title: Multiple Choice - Conversation Completion
description: Choose the correct response to complete the conversation.

questions.text:
Tom: 'What kind of TV show should we watch tonight?'
Mary: '______________________________'
options: I want to cook some hot soup for dinner.
Please wash your green school shirt now.
We should walk to the sports club today.
Let's watch that funny comedy to relax.
questions.correct_answer: Let's watch that funny comedy to relax.

questions.text:
Peter: 'Why do you love watching this cartoon every Sunday?'
Linda: '______________________________'
options: Because my brother walks to the city library.
Because the little puppy character is so cute.
Because our father buys a big brown table now.
Because the math homework is very hard for me.
questions.correct_answer: Because the little puppy character is so cute.

questions.text:
Kevin: 'That singer on the talent show sings wonderfully!'
Anna: '______________________________'
options: Yes, she is a truly brilliant performer.
No, our school begins at seven on Monday.
Yes, the kitchen floor is very clean now.
No, we must buy a new soccer ball today.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, she is a truly brilliant performer.

questions.text:
David: 'Do you know when the wildlife programme starts?'
Sarah: '______________________________'
options: Check the TV guide on the living room table.
Wash your dirty sports shoes after the match.
Buy two train tickets at the railway station.
Close the bedroom window because of the rain.
questions.correct_answer: Check the TV guide on the living room table.

questions.text:
Jack: 'Would you like to watch an animated film with me?'
Emma: '______________________________'
options: No, the bus arrives at the station now.
Yes, my sister has three white rabbits.
Yes, I would love to watch it with you.
No, I do not like eating sweet apples.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, I would love to watch it with you.

questions.text:
Mark: 'What do you think of this English channel?'
Lucy: '______________________________'
options: It costs too much money to buy a computer.
It has many educational programmes for kids.
It has four large wooden chairs in the room.
It is raining heavily outside on the street.
questions.correct_answer: It has many educational programmes for kids.

questions.text:
Grandpa: 'Why do you turn off the TV series, Nick?'
Nick: '______________________________'
options: Because my friends are swimming in the lake.
Because the hot tea is very sweet and tasty.
Because it is so boring and nothing happens.
Because our dog is sleeping under the table.
questions.correct_answer: Because it is so boring and nothing happens.

questions.text:
Alex: 'Do you want to watch the sports programme with us?'
Ben: '______________________________'
options: No, because my new bicycle has bright wheels.
No, because the library is very quiet today.
Yes, because I really love watching football.
Yes, because our bus goes to school at eight.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, because I really love watching football.

questions.text:
Teacher: 'Did you see that clever student on the game show?'
Student: '______________________________'
options: No, we should buy fresh bread for breakfast.
No, the weather is very cold in the morning.
Yes, my little brother can ride his bicycle.
Yes, he answers every question very quickly.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, he answers every question very quickly.

questions.text:
Sam: 'Is this music concert a live broadcast?'
Kelly: '______________________________'
options: Yes, my mother makes delicious apple pies.
Yes, the band is playing right on the stage.
No, we must borrow some storybooks at school.
No, the train leaves the station at ten a.m.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, the band is playing right on the stage.
